description:
We ran 12 real isolated agy CLI runs with Gemini 4 Argon High (6 Raw vs 6 with the Mixiuh Superpowers Kit).

With frontier models like Gemini 4 Argon High, are Skills, Memory Banks, and Browser Auto-Debuggers still necessary, or do they just burn extra tokens? We ran 12 real isolated benchmarks in Antigravity across 6 extreme WebGL/Canvas/WebAudio systems. Raw Gemini 4 Argon High won 2 rounds (Bullet-Hell Boss Rush in 51m vs 69m with 4x denser danmaku patterns, and 3D Zero-Trust Cyber Defense in just 5 agent steps for $0.74 vs $2.04). However, the Mixiuh Superpowers Kit won 4-2 overall—delivering 6.3x higher HFT order throughput (70,406 vs 11,073 ord/s, 16 minutes faster and cheaper), faster DAG + GLSL Raymarching compilation, zero console errors, and catching multi-window UI bugs in MixiuhOS.

DEMOS AND CODE
Download Mixiuh AI Superpowers Kit (Free): https://labs.mixiuh.online
Play all 12 real interactive demos from Episode 03: https://labs.mixiuh.online

- Stack: agy --model gemini-4-argon-high --effort high + Mixiuh Superpowers Kit v1.0.

The narration uses my own cloned voice with Voicefy (runs locally).
